prior_works.title: WebGPT: Improving the Factual Accuracy of Language Models through Web Browsing
prior_works.relationship_sentence: WebGPT established the paradigm of training a browsing-enabled QA agent with supervised + reinforcement learning to produce grounded answers and citations, and SearchArt positions itself as a scalable alternative by replacing expensive human-labelled browsing trajectories with large-scale synthetic, verification-filtered trajectories while retaining the RL/supervised training loop.

prior_works.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
prior_works.authors: Shunyu Yao, Jeffrey Zhao, Dian Yu, Nan Du, Izhak Shafran, Karthik Narasimhan, Yuan Cao
prior_works.relationship_sentence: ReAct introduced the explicit interleaving of reasoning traces and external actions (tool calls/queries) as training and prompting signals, directly inspiring SearchArt's emphasis on modeling and supervising intermediate search decisions and action-reasoning transitions in trajectories.

prior_works.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
prior_works.authors: Jason Wei, Xuezhi Wang, Dale Schuurmans, Maarten Bosma, Brian Ichter, Fei Xia, Ed Chi, Quoc Le, Denny Zhou
prior_works.relationship_sentence: Chain-of-Thought showed that exposing and supervising intermediate reasoning chains improves multi-step reasoning, providing the conceptual foundation for SearchArt's focus on optimizing not only final answers but the quality and structure of intermediate search/reasoning steps.

prior_works.title: HotpotQA: A Dataset for Diverse, Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
prior_works.relationship_sentence: HotpotQA formalized multi-hop, evidence-supported QA with annotated supporting facts, supplying the problem formulation and evaluation mindset (multi-step evidence aggregation and explainability) that SearchArt extends to long-horizon, web-scale search trajectories and synthetic evidence graphs.

prior_works.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
prior_works.authors: Timo Schick, Jane Dwivedi-Yu, Roberto Dessì, Roberta Raileanu, Maria Lomeli, Luke Zettlemoyer, Nicola Cancedda, Thomas Scialom
prior_works.relationship_sentence: Toolformer demonstrated self-supervised synthesis of tool-use examples by having models generate and validate API calls, directly motivating SearchArt's approach to large-scale synthetic generation of search trajectories combined with automated verification to produce training data for tool-enabled agents.

prior_works.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
prior_works.authors: Shunyu Yao, Dian Yu, Jeffrey Zhao, Izhak Shafran, Thomas L. Griffiths, Yuan Cao, Karthik Narasimhan
prior_works.relationship_sentence: Tree of Thoughts introduced structured branch-and-evaluate search over partial reasoning states to improve problem solving, motivating SearchArt's emphasis on evidence-branch selection, verification of intermediate branches, and training policies that expand or prune search branches adaptively.

synthesis_narrative: 针对诸如"WebGPT"这类浏览器赋能问答智能体的工作，发展出了将监督学习与强化学习相结合的训练配方，以从多步网页交互中生成有依据且带引用的答案，并确立了需要昂贵人工标注轨迹的基线智能体训练循环。"ReAct"等研究明确揭示了将推理轨迹与外部动作交错进行的价值，为中间决策点提供了实用表示；而"Chain-of-Thought"则表明，对中间推理步骤进行监督能实质性提升多步推理——这些工作共同为将轨迹视为一等训练信号提供了概念与表示工具。以"HotpotQA"为代表的数据集与问题形式化定义了带支撑事实的多跳问答及证据聚合评估，提供了SearchArt所面向的多跳、可解释问答框架。在方法上，"Toolformer"表明大语言模型能够大规模合成并自验证工具使用数据，提示了以模型驱动的合成语料替代昂贵人工标注的路径；而"Tree of Thoughts"定义了分支与评估的搜索动态，推动了对分支选择与验证的显式建模。综合这些脉络可见一个空白：先前系统要么依赖昂贵的人工验证，要么强调最终答案正确性而忽视轨迹质量与分支级验证。SearchArt自然地通过以下方式接续：将（Toolformer式）合成轨迹生成与轨迹级验证相结合，在WebGPT强化学习循环中训练智能体，并显式监督中间推理与分支选择（"ReAct"/"CoT"/"Tree-of-Thoughts"），以产生可扩展、高质量的长时程搜索策略。
